rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early massing with one dominant horizontal/crossed body and a meaningful carved court. It responds reasonably to the parcel outline and keeps a legible void figure rather than merely filling the site box. The blue access edge is acknowledged by the open court/entry seam logic, so the public threshold is not sealed. The form is still somewhat box-led and the section is relatively flat, but it remains plausible for neighborhood_living because the ground condition, courtyard, and upper mass hierarchy are intact. The silhouette is acceptable as a stepped/branched mass rather than a generic stack, though the roof/section could better express inhabited hierarchy or terrace depth.
